title: Privacy DataClassification fixes + keep Label-scope findings at minor
summary: Fixed factual errors in the privacy data-classification article about platform defaults and expanded the classification taxonomy to cover organization and account identifiers. Corrected label-scope findings severity from info to minor since no analyzer enforces this rule.
key_points: Corrected default DataClassification from SystemMetadata to ToBeClassified when omitted
Added OrganizationIdentifiableInformation for company VAT/registration numbers
Added AccountData for bank account numbers and IBANs
Reclassified label-scope style findings from info to minor severity
Label-scope is not enforced by any analyzer, so it should not be suppressed
